digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center transport retry layer
propositions: Jira Data Center rate-limit 429 responses are not honoured; a 429 propagates as a hard failure because JIRAError is excluded from the connection-retry set.
The fix must honour the Retry-After header with up to 20% jitter applied before clamping to MAX_BACKOFF_S, treating absent headers as the limiter being off.
Retrying 429s at the shared _with_connection_retry choke point would reintroduce the duplicate-issue class, since it fronts mutations like create_issue and a 429 can arrive after a write began.
429 retry must be scoped to idempotent reads via a per-call opt-in defaulting to OFF, reaching both _call_logged and direct _with_connection_retry paths such as get_comment_map's per-issue fetch.
On retry-cap exhaustion the code must raise BackendHTTPError(code=429) through _as_backend_http_error and never leak the raw JIRAError past the adapter boundary.
The ticket was split into S1 (behaviour-preserving extraction of the retry/error cluster into retry.py, forced by the locked 800-line module cap) and S2 (the 429 policy), with S2 depending on S1.
